newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SMB United Ltd offers 103.13 mln shares in IPO.
newsitem.headline: SMB United Ltd offers 103.13 mln shares in IPO.

text.p: Singapore's SMB United Ltd said on Monday it was offering 1.03.13 million shares at Singapore $0.29 cents each in its initial public offer (IPO).
The public offer comprises 82.5 million new shares and 20.63 million vendor shares, the company said in a statement.
The shares have a par value of S$0.10 each and are priced at a forecast price/earnings (P/E) ratio of 11.7 times.

SMB, a manufacturer of electric switch gears and supplier of electrical components for power distribution and control, said the net proceeds from the IPO of S$22.20 million would be used to buy a new factory in Singapore, set up a plant in Malaysia and finance overseas expansion.
Group turnover in 1995 was S$44.00 million and pre-tax profits were S$11.00 million dollars.
SMB has forecast that in 1996 group sales would reach S$52.5 million and pre-tax profits S$11.90 million.
